name: zanker-visual-forensics
description: Reproduce a visual defect, isolate root cause, apply the smallest appropriate fix and verify.

workflow.instruction: Record viewport, state, reproduction path and original screenshot.
Use `bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/diagnose.sh` and `bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/audit.sh` for browser evidence where available.
Form two or more hypotheses, test one variable at a time, trace shared component usage.
Apply minimal patch in worktree; compare before/after and verify neighboring layouts.

fallback: Supply hypothesis plus a concrete reproducible browser check; do not pretend certainty.
